frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).

release_notes: Night Owl CAM-FTN4-BU: a 4MP wired-IP (PoE) deterrence bullet camera with motion-activated spotlights, 100 ft night vision and two-way audio; add-on for Night Owl FTN8 series NVRs. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor from the product listing.
